title: Jigaku Gōka
body:
Syntax: perform jigaku gouka <target>

Description: A tormenting illusion that can dull the target's reflexes.  Usable with any chakra nature. Base damage: 301-357. 65% chance to inflict narakumi. The effect lasts 24 seconds before resistance. Unlocks at level 52. Costs 44 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 5 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
